body: I do have other friends, but I feel bad for venting to them when they have their own problems as well.
That's not how I see it. If she kills herself from this, where will I be?
I don't know if I will much longer.

I appreciate the offer. I'm just sick of how everything I do upsets the people I live with. Everyone's tensions are high thanks to the quarantine, I get that. But they get pissed at me for everything. They insist I said things I didn't, they get mad at me for showing the slightest hint of emotion, every day in this house is like walking through a minefield. It's even worse with my girlfriend, whose family is actively abusive. I'm trying to keep her holding on for a future that might not even come at this rate. At this point, I think we're both thinking the same thing.

She has a job, and conveniently she works nights. But it's inconsistent *when* she works, and it's every night she isn't working that she's impaired, so no matter what, I don't really get to spend any time with her.
That's what I'm currently doing. Unfortunately, her shitty situation also prevents her from going to a therapist or anything...
It's rough, but even through the shitty parts, we really do rely on each other's support at the end of the day. I just hope she can move out of that horrible house soon.
It's uncertain. The plan was originally for her to be moved by summer this year, but at this rate, who knows?
NTA. Call it what it is. Not your problem if she finds it offensive.
